decoded.meaning: BATCH{ TIME u64=1700000000000000000, VALUE[10] } — a packed batch whose block length (10) is not a multiple of the descriptor's width (4): MALFORMED under RFC-0025 §4.1.4 (Amendment 5), so a consumer delivers NONE of its samples
decoded.note: the codec still decodes and round-trips these bytes — malformed is a reader's answer about the packed convention, not a framing error (05-protocol-tlvs.md §User range). Delivering the two whole frames and dropping the tail is exactly what the rule forbids
